fact: A progress review at MICSTI and the National University of Lesotho received a presentation of X-Road as a system to connect government ministries and enable electronic information sharing, among systems that 'will modernize' services; no service date or connected bodies are given.

fact: The Ministry of ICT (MICSTI) with UNICEF Lesotho held a workshop on 20-23 October 2026 in Berea to plan an X-Road pilot, assess ministries' readiness to join the National Data Exchange and set an implementation roadmap.
